recurring_rules_shape.name: recurring_rules_shape
recurring_rules_shape.value:
case "recurring_rules"."frequency"
            when 'weekly'   then "recurring_rules"."day_of_week" is not null
            when 'biweekly' then "recurring_rules"."day_of_week" is not null
            when 'monthly'  then "recurring_rules"."day_of_month" is not null
            when 'yearly'   then "recurring_rules"."day_of_month" is not null and "recurring_rules"."month_of_year" is not null
          end

installment_payments_paid_requires_date.name: installment_payments_paid_requires_date
installment_payments_paid_requires_date.value:
("installment_payments"."status" = 'pending' and "installment_payments"."paid_date" is null)
       or ("installment_payments"."status" = 'paid' and "installment_payments"."paid_date" is not null)

transactions_transfer_shape.name: transactions_transfer_shape
transactions_transfer_shape.value:
case when "transactions"."type" = 'transfer'
             then "transactions"."transfer_account_id" is not null
                  and "transactions"."transfer_account_id" <> "transactions"."account_id"
             else "transactions"."transfer_account_id" is null end

transactions_category_shape.name: transactions_category_shape
transactions_category_shape.value:
case when "transactions"."type" = 'transfer'
             then "transactions"."category_id" is null
             else "transactions"."category_id" is not null end
